qe: Which statutory regulatory body regulates telecommunication services, tariffs, and consumer interests in India?
qh: भारत में दूरसंचार सेवाओं, टैरिफ और उपभोक्ता हितों को विनियमित करने वाला वैधानिक निकाय कौन सा है?
o: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
e: Telecom sevaon aur unke tarif (daam) ko niyantrit karne wali statutory sanstha Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) hai, jo TRAI Act, 1997 ke teht bani - iska kaam operators ke beech interconnection (ek network se doosre network par call), quality of service ke manak aur upbhokta (consumer) ke hito ki raksha hai, aur ye niyam todne par jurya (penalty) bhi lagati hai. NITI Aayog ek niti (policy) think-tank hai jiske paas niyamak (regulatory) shakti nahi hai, CVC sarkari karmachariyon ki sachchai (integrity) dekhta hai, aur SEBI share bazaar ka niyamak hai - inka telecom se koi sambandh nahi. Exam point: telecom ka niyamak = TRAI (TRAI Act, 1997); vibhinn kshetraon ke niyamak alag hain - RBI bank, SEBI securities, IRDAI bima.

qe: Under the Bihar Lokayukta Act, what is the jurisdictional coverage regarding state public servants?
qh: बिहार लोकायुक्त अधिनियम के तहत राज्य के लोक सेवकों के संबंध में क्या क्षेत्राधिकार है?
o: Covers all public servants from Group A down to Group D, including the Chief Minister and State Ministers
Covers only Group A gazetted officers
e: Bihar Lokayukta ka kshetraadhikar (jurisdiction) rajya ke sabhi lok sevakon par faila hua hai - Group A, B, C aur D sabhi varg ke adhikari-karmachari iske daayre mein aate hain, aur mukhya mantri aur rajya mantriyon ke khilaf bhi jaanch ho sakti hai (kuchh seemit apvaad ke saath). Iska aadhar yahi tark hai ki bhrashtachar chhoti ya badi naukri dekh kar nahi hota, isliye samvidhanik sansthaon ke kuchh padadhikariyon ko chhod kar baaki sabhi cover hote hain. 'Keval Group A', 'keval chune hue pratinidhi' ya 'keval police' wale vikalp Bihar Lokayukta Act ke daayre ko chhota dikhate hain. Exam point: Bihar Lokayukta = Group A se D tak sabhi lok sevak + mukhya mantri/mantri bhi uske daayre mein.

qe: The National Statistical Commission (NSC) of India is headed by:
qh: राष्ट्रीय सांख्यिकी आयोग (NSC) की अध्यक्षता किसके द्वारा की जाती है?
o: An eminent professional statistician or social scientist
The Governor of the Reserve Bank of India
e: Rashtriya Sankhyiki Aayog (National Statistical Commission) ke adhyaksh (Chairperson) koi prashiddh sankhyiki-vid (statistician) ya samaj-vigyanik hote hain - koi mantri ya sarkari padadhikari nahi, kyunki is aayog ka kaam desh ki data vyavastha par nishpaksh (impartial) jaankari aur sujhav dena hai (Rangarajan Committee 2005 ki sifarish par bani). Mukhya karyapalika adhikari (CEO) ek senior adhikari hote hain, lekin adhyaksh prashiddh (eminent) vyakti hi hote hain. Vitta mantri, pradhan mantri ya RBI governor apne-apne kshetra ke padadhikari hain aur is aayog ke adhyaksh nahi. Exam point: NSC ka adhyaksh = prashiddh sankhyik/samaj vigyanik; aayog aankdon (data) par salah deti hai, niyamak nahi hai.

qe: Under which Act was the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) established?
qh: भारतीय बीमा विनियामक और विकास प्राधिकरण (IRDAI) की स्थापना किस अधिनियम के तहत की गई थी?
e: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) ki sthapna IRDA Act, 1999 ke teht hui - 1999 se pehle bima kshetra par 1938 ke Insurance Act ka niyantran tha, par udarikaran (liberalisation) ke baad ek alag niyamak ki zarurat padi, jisne bima prem (premium) aur insurance company ke nivesh (investment) ke niyam tay kiye. Insurance Act, 1938 bima ke vyavsay ka purana aadhar-kaanoon hai (usmein kai sanshodhan hote rahe), par IRDAI ka janm 1999 wale kanoon se hi hua. Haan, iska naam 1999 ke Act mein 'IRDA' tha jise baad mein 'IRDAI' kaha gaya. Exam point: IRDAI = IRDA Act, 1999; iska mukhyaalay Hyderabad mein, bima kshetra ka niyamak.

qe: What judicial status does the Competition Commission of India (CCI) hold during its inquiries?
qh: जांच के दौरान भारतीय प्रतिस्पर्धा आयोग (CCI) को किस न्यायालय का दर्जा प्राप्त होता है?
o: A Constitutional bench equivalent to a High Court
A Criminal Court with power to award imprisonment directly
A Quasi-Judicial body with powers of a Civil Court under the Code of Civil Procedure (CPC)
e: Competition Commission of India (CCI) ek quasi-judicial sanstha hai - yani aadhe nyayik (judicial) aur aadhe prashasnik (administrative) gun wali sanstha, jise Competition Act, 2002 ke teht Civil Court ke samaan shaktiyan mili hain. Jaanch ke dauran wo gawahon ko bulwa sakti hai, shapath-patra lekar sakshya le sakti hai, dastavez (documents) maang sakti hai aur public record talab kar sakti hai; uske aadesh ke khilaf COMPAT/NCLAT mein appeal ja sakti hai. Lekin CCI koi Criminal Court nahi hai jise seedha jail ki saza sunane ka adhikar ho, aur na hi ye High Court jaisi samvidhanik bench hai. Exam point: CCI = quasi-judicial body with civil court powers (Competition Act, 2002), criminal court jaisi shakti nahi.

qe: From which source is the operational budget of the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) funded?
qh: राष्ट्रीय मानवाधिकार आयोग (NHRC) का बजट कहाँ से प्रदान किया जाता है?
o: Grants sanctioned by the Central Government via the Ministry of Home Affairs
Through direct judicial levies collected by the Supreme Court
Annual contributions from State Governments proportionally
United Nations human rights development fund
e: NHRC ka karyakari (operational) budget kendra sarkar ke anudaan (grants) se chalta hai, jo sansad ke viniyog (appropriations) ke through Grih Mantralaya (Ministry of Home Affairs) ke zariye released hota hai - Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993 ke teht NHRC ko kendra sarkar ke anudaan se hi paisa milta hai (NHRC ki vaarshik report aur kharch ka lekha-jokha bhi isi vyavastha ke daayre mein aata hai). Supreme Court ki juryaon (levies), rajyaon ka saamaanya hissa (proportional contribution) ya videshi (United Nations) fund iske aadhar nahi hain. Exam point: NHRC ki funding = kendra sarkar ke grant-in-aid (Grih Mantralaya ke zariye), PHR Act 1993 ke teht.

qe: Which body initially monitored 'Anti-Profiteering' violations under GST before its operational functions were transferred to the CCI in December 2022?
qh: दिसंबर 2022 में CCI को कार्य सौंपे जाने से पहले GST के तहत 'मुनाफाखोरी रोधी' मामलों की निगरानी कौन करता था?
o: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)
e: GST vyavastha mein 'anti-profiteering' ka matlab yahi tha ki GST dar (rate) ya input tax credit ka laabh (benefit) upbhokta (consumer) tak pahunchna chahiye, aur vyapari usse apni jeb mein na daale. Iski nigrani ke liye sabse pehle National Anti-Profiteering Authority (NAA) banayi gayi thi, aur December 2022 mein iska karyakal samapt hone par ye kaam Competition Commission of India (CCI) ko de diya gaya - kyunki profiteering (adhik munafe) competition ke usool se bhi juda mudda hai. SFIO company fraud dekhti hai, GST Council niyam-banane wali sanstha hai aur CBIC wasooli (collection) dekhta hai - inke paas ye mandate nahi tha. Exam point: GST anti-profiteering = pehle NAA (2017-2022), uske baad CCI ke paas (Dec 2022 se).

qe: In central ministries and departments, who generally functions as the Chief Vigilance Officer (CVO)?
qh: मंत्रालयों और विभागों में मुख्य सतर्कता अधिकारी (CVO) आमतौर पर कौन होता है?
o: A senior administrative officer (usually Joint Secretary / Director level) appointed with CVC approval
A serving police inspector general from state cadre
A nominee directly appointed by the Supreme Court
An external corporate auditor appointed by contract
e: Kendra ke mantralaya/departments mein Chief Vigilance Officer (CVO) ke roop mein aam taur par ek senior prashasnik adhikari (usually Joint Secretary ya Director star) niyukt hota hai, aur is niyukti ke liye Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) ki sahmati (approval) zaroori hoti hai. CVO ka kaam apne mantralaya ke andar bhrashtachar (corruption) ya aniyamita ke aaropon ki prarambhik jaanch karana, precuation ke sujhav dena aur CVC ko report bhejna hai. Police ka inspector general, Supreme Court dwara naamit vyakti ya bahari corporate auditor CVO ka pad nahi pa sakta, kyunki ye sarkari vyavastha ke andar ki nigrani ki jagah hai, bahari audit nahi. Exam point: CVO = ministry ka senior administrative officer (JS/Director level), CVC ki approval se; andar ki vigilance jaanch karta hai.

qe: Who heads the statutory selection committee for the appointment of the Lokayukta in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में लोकायुक्त की नियुक्ति के लिए वैधानिक चयन समिति की अध्यक्षता कौन करता है?
o: The Speaker of the Bihar Legislative Assembly
The Chief Justice of the Patna High Court
e: Bihar Lokayukta ki niyukti ke liye jo statutory chayan samiti (selection committee) banaayi gayi hai, uski adhyakshta mukhya mantri (Chief Minister) karte hain; is samiti mein vidhan sabha ke Adhyaksh, vidhan sabha mein vipaksh ke Neta, vidhan parishad ke Adhyaksh/Sabha ke vishisht sadasya aur Patna High Court ke Mukhya Nyayadhish (ya unke dwara naamit nyayadhish) jaise sadasya hote hain. Rajyapal is samiti ki sifarish par Lokayukta ki niyukti karte hain, isliye Rajyapal 'adhyaksh' nahi hote. Speaker, High Court ke Chief Justice ya Rajyapal is samiti ke adhyaksh nahi hain - unki bhoomika sadasya ki hai. Exam point: Bihar Lokayukta ki chayan samiti ki adhyakshta = mukhya mantri; niyukti Rajyapal karte hain.

qe: Which agency is primarily mandated to investigate high-value counterfeit currency cases involving terror-funding links under the UAPA?
qh: यूएपीए के तहत आतंकी वित्तपोषण से जुड़े उच्च मूल्य के नकली नोटों के मामलों की जांच का प्राथमिक दायित्व किसका है?
o: Reserve Bank of India Financial Intelligence Cell
e: Jaali mudra (counterfeit currency) ke aise mamlon mein jahan aatankvad (terror) ki funding ka sambandh ho, jaanch National Investigation Agency (NIA) karti hai - UAPA (Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act) aur NIA Act, 2008 ke teht FICN (Fake Indian Currency Notes) aur aatankiya karyavahi se juda aapraadh schedule mein aata hai, isliye NIA ke paas vishesh shaktiyan hain. ED (Enforcement Directorate) PMLA/FEMA wale dhan (money) traficking ke mamlon mein aata hai, par yahan 'primarily mandated agency' NIA hi hai; CBDT direct tax dekhta hai aur RBI ki koi 'Financial Intelligence Cell' jaisi anisi jaanch agency nahi hai (RBI ke paas FIU-IND ek alag sanstha hai). Exam point: terror-funding se jude jaali note ke mamle = NIA (UAPA + NIA Act schedule), ED nahi.

qe: Is NITI Aayog classified as a 'Public Authority' under the purview of the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005?
qh: क्या नीति आयोग सूचना का अधिकार (RTI) अधिनियम, 2005 के तहत 'सार्वजनिक प्राधिकरण' है?
o: Only its statistical wing is covered
Exempt under Section 24 of the RTI Act
No, because it is an executive policy think-tank
Yes, as it is a government body substantially financed by the Central Government
e: NITI Aayog RTI Act, 2005 ke teht 'public authority' maani jaati hai - kyunki wo kendra sarkar ne banayi hai, uske kharch ka bada hissa kendra sarkar ke bhandaar (budget) se aata hai, uske paas adhikari aur record hote hain, isliye usse jaankari maangi ja sakti hai. Section 24 ki chhoot (exemption) khaas soochna (intelligence/security) sansthaon ko milti hai, aur NITI Aayog us soochi mein nahi hai; haan, yoja ke naam par kuchh strategic documents par chhoot mil sakti hai, par poori sanstha exempt nahi hai. 'Executive think-tank hone se chhoot' wala vikalp galat hai, kyunki RTI ka aadhar sanstha ka public nature hai, uske kaam ka naam nahi. Exam point: NITI Aayog = RTI ke daayre mein aane wali public authority (Section 24 exempt list mein nahi).

qe: Which regulatory authority governs and supervises Micro-Finance Institutions (NBFC-MFIs) in India?
qh: भारत में माइक्रो-फाइनेंस संस्थानों (NBFC-MFIs) को कौन सा विनियामक प्राधिकरण नियंत्रित और पर्यवेक्षित करता है?
o: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
e: Gramin aur chhote star ke micro-finance karz dene wali sansthaon (NBFC-MFIs) ko niyantrit karne wala adhikari Reserve Bank of India (RBI) hai, kyunki wo non-banking financial companies ki shreni mein aati hain aur unhe RBI se registration lena padta hai; RBI unke interest ke niyam, karz ka aakaar aur grahitaon (borrowers) ki jaankari ke rules tay karta hai. PFRDA pension, SEBI securities aur Gramin Vikas Mantralaya (Ministry of Rural Development) schemes ke saath juda hai - inse micro-finance ka niyamak kaam nahi hota. Self-help group (SHG) ke bank linkage wale kaam mein NABARD refinance ya sahyog deta hai, par niyamak RBI hi rehta hai. Exam point: NBFC-MFI = RBI ke daayre mein (registration + niyam), NABARD sirf refinance/developmental sahyog.

qe: Under the Right to Information Act, 2005, what is the statutory composition of the Central Information Commission (CIC)?
qh: सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम, 2005 के तहत केंद्रीय सूचना आयोग (CIC) की संरचना क्या है?
o: A single Chief Commissioner assisted by judicial secretaries
Chief Information Commissioner and not more than 10 Information Commissioners
Chief Information Commissioner and 15 Information Commissioners
Chief Information Commissioner and exactly 5 Information Commissioners
e: RTI Act, 2005 ke Section 12(2) ke anusaar Central Information Commission (CIC) mein ek Mukhya Soochna Aayukta (Chief Information Commissioner) ke saath 10 se adhik Information Commissioners nahi ho sakte - yani kul milakar 1 + 10 = 11 tak ka gathan sambhav hai. 2019 ke RTI sanshodhan ne aayuktaon ke karyakal (tenure) aur vetan (salary) ke niyam badle, lekin gathan ki chhat (ceiling) nahi badli. Isi tarah rajya soochna aayog (SIC) mein bhi ek Chief + adhiktam 10 aayukta ho sakte hain, jo rajya kshetra ke liye kaam karte hain. 'Exactly 5', '15' ya 'judicial secretaries' wale vikalp samvidhan ke aankdon se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: CIC = Chief Information Commissioner + adhiktam 10 Information Commissioners (Section 12(2), RTI Act 2005).

qe: Which Indian regulatory body represents the nation as the National Codex Contact Point for international food standards?
qh: अंतरराष्ट्रीय खाद्य मानकों के लिए कौन सा भारतीय विनियामक निकाय राष्ट्रीय कोडेक्स संपर्क बिंदु के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA)
e: Khaadya (food) ke antarrashtriya manakon (standards) tay karne wali sanstha Codex Alimentarius Commission hai, aur Bharat mein uske 'National Codex Contact Point' ka kaam Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) karta hai - yani FSSAI hi Codex ki baithakon mein desh ka pratinidhitva karta hai aur vaishvik khaadya manakon ke saath desi manakon ka taalmel (alignment) banata hai. Codex FAO aur WHO dwara chalayi jaati hai. Upbhokta Mamla Mantralaya niti dekhta hai, FCI anaaj (grains) ke bhandaar aur vitaran (distribution) ka kaam dekhti hai aur APEDA krishi utpaadon ke niryat (exports) ko badhava deti hai. Exam point: Bharat ka National Codex Contact Point = FSSAI (FSS Act, 2006 ke teht khaadya manak ka niyamak).

qe: What is the statutory limitation period for filing a corruption complaint before the Lokayukta of Bihar?
qh: बिहार के लोकायुक्त के समक्ष भ्रष्टाचार की शिकायत दर्ज करने की समय-सीमा क्या है?
o: Within 1 year of the alleged occurrence
Within 5 years from the date on which the offense is alleged to have been committed
e: Bihar Lokayukta ke saamne bhrashtachar ki shikayat (complaint) dene ke liye kanoon mein 5 saal ki samay-seema (limitation period) tay ki gayi hai - yani jis taareekh ko aaropit karyavahi hui, usse 5 saal ke andar hi shikayat deni hoti hai; is samay ke baad aambol (complaint) sunne layak nahi maana jaata. Yahi seema isliye rakhi gayi hai ki purane mamlon mein sakshya (evidence) nashth ho jaata hai aur jaanch ka koi labh nahi hota; 1 saal ya 10 saal wale vikalp Bihar ke kanoon mein nahi hain, aur 'koi seema nahi' bhi galat hai. Lokayukta ki jaanch ke baad sifarish (recommendation) aur karyavahi ki prakriya aage chalti hai. Exam point: Bihar Lokayukta mein brashtachar ki shikayat ki samay-seema = 5 saal (karyavahi ki taareekh se).

qe: Which organization formulates and publishes the annual 'SDG India Index' measuring States' progress across global sustainability goals?
qh: वैश्विक सतत विकास लक्ष्यों पर राज्यों की प्रगति को मापने वाला वार्षिक 'SDG इंडिया इंडेक्स' कौन प्रकाशित करता है?
o: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
e: 'SDG India Index' ko NITI Aayog taiyaar karta hai aur ye rajyaon/sangha kshetraon (UTs) ki sustainable development goals par pragati (progress) ko aankta hai - ismein 13-17 soochak (indicators) hote hain, har lakshya ke liye score milta hai aur 'front runner', 'performer', 'aspirant' jaisi shreniyan banti hain, taaki rajyaon ke beech swasthya (competitive) tulna (comparison) ho sake. MoSPI aankdon (data) ka sanchay karta hai, Finance Commission rajyaon ko vittiya hissa (devolution) deta hai aur UNDP ek videshi sanstha hai - inmein se koi ye index jaari nahi karta. Pehla SDG India Index 2018 mein aaya tha. Exam point: SDG India Index = NITI Aayog ka jaari kiya, rajyaon ki SDG pragati ka aankalan (MoSPI ke data par aadharit).

qe: Under which statute was the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) established as a statutory body?
qh: पेंशन निधि विनियामक और विकास प्राधिकरण (PFRDA) को किस कानून के तहत वैधानिक दर्जा दिया गया था?
e: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) ki sthapna PFRDA Act, 2013 ke teht hui - yani ye ek statutory body hai jo National Pension System (NPS) aur Atal Pension Yojana jaise pension utpaadon ko niyantrit karti hai, pension fund managers ko panjikrit (register) karti hai aur grahitaon (subscribers) ke hito ki raksha karti hai. 2013 se pehle PFRDA ek executive (sarkari aadesh se bani) sanstha thi, sirf kanoon aane ke baad use statutory darja mila; isliye 'Insurance Regulatory Act', EPF Act ya Finance Act wale vikalp galat hain (wo bima, bhavishya nidhi aur vitta sambandhi kanoon hain). Exam point: PFRDA = PFRDA Act, 2013 ke teht statutory regulator (pension kshetra; NPS aur APY iske daayre mein).

qe: Under the provisions of which environmental statute was the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) constituted?
qh: केंद्रीय प्रदूषण नियंत्रण बोर्ड (CPCB) का गठन किस पर्यावरण अधिनियम के प्रावधानों के तहत किया गया था?
o: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981
e: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) ki sthapna Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974 ke teht hui - ye kanoon jal pradushan (water pollution) rokne ke liye bana tha, aur isi ke teht kendra star par CPCB aur rajyaon mein State Pollution Control Boards (SPCB) banaye gaye. Baad mein Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981 ke teht CPCB ko hawa (air) pradushan ki nigrani ki shaktiyan bhi mili, isliye aaj CPCB jal aur hawa dono dekhta hai. NGT Act, 2010 ek nyayik (tribunal) vyavastha hai aur Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 ek chhatri (umbrella) kanoon hai - dono mein CPCB ki sthapna nahi hui. Exam point: CPCB = Water Act, 1974 ke teht sthapit; Air Act, 1981 ne uske kaam ka vistar kiya.

qe: Does the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) possess an independent investigation cadre?
qh: क्या राष्ट्रीय मानवाधिकार आयोग (NHRC) के पास अपना स्वतंत्र जांच तंत्र होता है?
o: Yes, it has its own investigation division headed by a Director General of Police (DGP) rank officer
Investigation can be conducted only by judicial magistrates
No, it must rely exclusively on local state police
It relies exclusively on CBI investigators
e: NHRC ke paas apni alag jaanch vyavastha (investigation division) hai, jiski adhyakshta ek Director General of Police (DGP) star ke adhikari karte hain - Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993 aur uske sanshodhan NHRC ko ye shakti dete hain ki wo apne staff se ya kisi anya jaanch agency se suchanayein jama karaye. Jarurat padne par NHRC CBI se bhi sahyog le sakta hai, par wo keval CBI par nirbhar nahi hai; isi tarah usse mansik (sirf) nyayik record dekhne ya state police ki report ka intezaar karne wali baat bhi galat hai. Ye jaanch vyavastha NHRC ko svatantrata (autonomy) deti hai. Exam point: NHRC = apni investigation division (DGP-rank adhikari ke netritva mein), PHR Act 1993 ke teht.

qe: Which regulatory body fixes and revises the ceiling prices of essential scheduled medicines under the Drug Price Control Orders (DPCO)?
qh: ड्रग प्राइस कंट्रोल ऑर्डर (DPCO) के तहत आवश्यक दवाओं की अधिकतम कीमतें कौन तय करता है?
o: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
e: Essenshal dawaon ki chhat (ceiling) keemtaun aur unke sanshodhan (revision) ka kaam National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) karta hai, jo Drug Price Control Orders (DPCO) ke teht dawa ke daam tay karta hai - iska kaam scheduled dawaon ke retail price ki seema, nayi dawaon ka price approval aur dawa ke daam ki nigrani hai. Ye kendra ke Rasayan aur Khad (Chemicals and Fertilizers) Mantralaya ke dawa vibhag (Department of Pharmaceuticals) ke aadhin ek attached office hai. CDSCO dawa ki gunwatta (quality) aur manzoori (licensing) dekhta hai, PCI pharmacist ki padchinh (registration) dekhti hai aur FSSAI khaadya ka niyamak hai - daam tay karna inka kaam nahi hai. Exam point: dawa ke ceiling price/DPCO = NPPA (Department of Pharmaceuticals ke aadhin), gunwatta = CDSCO.

qe: Bihar falls under the operational jurisdiction of which Zonal Council established under the States Reorganisation Act, 1956?
qh: राज्य पुनर्गठन अधिनियम 1956 के तहत बिहार किस क्षेत्रीय परिषद (Zonal Council) के अधिकार क्षेत्र में आता है?
e: Bihar purvi (Eastern) Zonal Council ke kshetraadhikar mein aata hai, kyunki Zonal Councils ki vyavastha States Reorganisation Act, 1956 ke teht hui thi aur Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Odisha ko purvi zonal council mein rakha gaya (baad mein Jharkhand alag rajya banne par bhi wahi raha). In councils ka maksad rajyaon ke beech samanvay badhana, aapsi vivadon ke hal ke liye raasta dhoondhna aur vikas ke mamlon par mil baith kar salah karna hai; inki adhyakshta kendra ke Grih Mantri (Union Home Minister) karte hain aur mukhya mantri vice-chairman ki tarah rotation par kaam karte hain. Central, Northern ya North-Eastern council alag rajyaon ke group hain, jismein Bihar nahi aata. Exam point: Bihar = Eastern Zonal Council (States Reorganisation Act, 1956), adhyakshta Grih Mantri.

qe: Under which statutory enactment does the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) operate as the national nodal agency for cyber incidents?
qh: भारतीय कंप्यूटर आपातकालीन प्रतिक्रिया टीम (CERT-In) किस कानून के तहत साइबर सुरक्षा की राष्ट्रीय नोडल एजेंसी के रूप में कार्य करती है?
e: CERT-In (Indian Computer Emergency Response Team) cyber suraksha ke muddon par desh ki nodal agency hai jo Information Technology Act, 2000 ke Section 70B ke teht sthapit hai - ye cyber ghatnaon (incidents) ki soochna dene, unka samanvay karne, cyber hamlon ki suchna jari karne aur suraksha ke sujhav dene ka kaam karti hai, aur sarkari-private dono kshetraon ko iske daayre mein rakha gaya hai. Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act ek aatankvad-viridhi (anti-terror) kanoon hai, 'National Cyber Security Act, 2013' naam ka koi kanoon nahi hai, aur Telecommunications Act, 2023 telecom ke niyaman ke liye hai - cyber incident response inka kaam nahi. Exam point: CERT-In = IT Act, 2000 ka Section 70B; MeitY ke aadhin cyber incident response agency.

qe: Under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993, what is the statutory limit on the monetary damages or punitive fines the NHRC can directly impose on a guilty official?
qh: मानव अधिकार संरक्षण अधिनियम 1993 के तहत NHRC दोषी अधिकारी पर सीधे कितना जुर्माना लगा सकता है?
o: Zero; it cannot directly impose punitive fines or punish, but can only recommend compensation or prosecution to governments
Up to Rs. 50,000 deducted from monthly salary
e: NHRC ek salahkaar (recommendatory) sanstha hai, isliye Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993 ke teht wo kisi doshi (guilty) adhikari par khud koi dand (fine) nahi laga sakti - wo keval sarkar ko sifarish kar sakti hai, jaise peedit ko muavza (compensation), doshi ke khilaf karyavahi ya vishleshan (disciplinary proceedings). Iska asar isliye banta hai ki report sansad/rajya vidhan mandal ke saamne aati hai aur sarkar ko kuchh samay mein apni karyavahi ki soochna deni hoti hai. 'Rs 1 lakh', 'Rs 5 lakh' ya 'salary se 50,000 katta' jaisi koi seedhi dand-shakti NHRC ke paas nahi hai (aise aankde anya pravdhanon mein milte hain). Exam point: NHRC ke paas dand lagane ki shakti nahi - wo recommendatory hai; muavza/prosecution ki sifarish hi kar sakti hai.

qe: Which administrative ministry/department acts as the nodal policymaking agency for administering the Right to Information Act, 2005?
qh: सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम 2005 के प्रशासन के लिए कौन सा मंत्रालय/विभाग नोडल एजेंसी के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT), Ministry of Personnel
e: RTI Act, 2005 ko lagu karne aur chalaane ki niti ke liye nodal department Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT) hai, jo Karmik tatha Prashikshan Mantralaya (Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions) ke aadhin aata hai - RTI ke niyam, aayuktaon ki niyukti ki prakriya aur soochna adhikariyon ki training ka kaam DoPT dekhta hai. Central Information Commission (CIC) ek quasi-judicial appeal body hai; uska sachivalaya (secretariat) keval commission ke karyalay ka kaam dekhta hai, niyam nahi banata. Vidhi aur Nyay Mantralaya kanoon ke masawde bana sakta hai aur Grih Mantralaya andar ki suraksha dekhta hai. Exam point: RTI ka nodal department = DoPT (Ministry of Personnel); CIC apni appeal sunne wali sanstha hai.

qe: Who presides as the permanent Chairman of the 'Kendriya Hindi Samiti' responsible for apex Hindi language promotion guidelines?
qh: सर्वोच्च स्तर पर हिंदी भाषा को बढ़ावा देने वाले दिशानिर्देश तय करने वाली 'केंद्रीय हिंदी समिति' की अध्यक्षता कौन करता है?
e: Kendriya Hindi Samiti ki adhyakshta Pradhan Mantri (Prime Minister) karte hain - ye Hindi ke istemal aur vikas ke liye sarvochch (apex) salahkaar samiti hai jo varsh 1967 mein bani thi aur Rajbhasha Vibhag (Official Language Department) ke teht aati hai; iska kaam Hindi ke prasar ke sujhav dena, samitis ka kaam dekhna aur rajya sarkaron/ministries ko Hindi ke mamle mein salah dena hai. Adhyaksh Pradhan Mantri hone se is samiti ko sarvochch mahatva milta hai; kendra ke Grih Mantri, Shiksha Mantri ya rashtrapati iski adhyakshta nahi karte (rashtrapati ek sanrakshak jaisi high position rakhte hain, par samiti ke adhyaksh nahi hain). Exam point: Kendriya Hindi Samiti ka adhyaksh = Pradhan Mantri; ye Rajbhasha Vibhag ke andar aati hai.

qe: The Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO) is organized as a multidisciplinary statutory investigating wing under which Ministry?
qh: गंभीर धोखाधड़ी जांच कार्यालय (SFIO) किस मंत्रालय के तहत एक बहु-विषयक वैधानिक जांच एजेंसी है?
e: Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO) ek bahu-vishayak (multidisciplinary) statutory jaanch wing hai jo Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) ke aadhin kaam karta hai - Companies Act, 2013 ke Section 212 ke teht ye kampaon ke gambhir dhokha (fraud) ki jaanch karti hai aur ismein vittiya (finance), lekha (accounts), kanoon aur takniki kshetra ke visheshagya shaamil hote hain. Grih Mantralaya, Vitta Mantralaya ya Cabinet Secretariat iske prashasnik niyantran mein nahi hain (halaanki jaanch ke dauran SFIO dusri agencies se sahyog leti hai). SFIO ka mukhya kaam fraud ka pata lagana aur adalat mein muqadma chalane ke liye samagri jama karna hai. Exam point: SFIO = Ministry of Corporate Affairs ke aadhin, Companies Act 2013 ke Section 212 ki jaanch agency.

qe: Which statutory commission replaced the erstwhile Medical Council of India (MCI) in September 2020 to regulate medical education and profession?
qh: चिकित्सा शिक्षा और पेशे को विनियमित करने के लिए सितंबर 2020 में भारतीय चिकित्सा परिषद (MCI) की जगह किस आयोग ने ली?
e: Medical Council of India (MCI) ki jagah September 2020 se National Medical Commission (NMC) aa gayi - National Medical Commission Act, 2019 ke teht sthapit is aayog ka kaam chikitsa shiksha (medical education) ke manak tay karna, doctoron ki padchinh (registration) ki nayi vyavastha aur etiksa ke niyam lagu karna hai; iske teht chaar bade board (UG, PG, medical assessment aur ethics) jaise kaam bhi hote hain. 'Medical Assessment and Rating Board' NMC ke andar ka ek khanda (body) hai, poori jagah lene wali sanstha nahi; 'National Health Regulatory Authority' jaisi anisi sanstha nahi hai aur CCIM ayurved-unani (traditional medicine) ke liye alag aayog hai. Exam point: MCI ko hata kar National Medical Commission (NMC) aayi, NMC Act 2019 ke teht September 2020 se.

qe: How many religious minority communities are notified at the national level under the National Commission for Minorities Act, 1992?
qh: राष्ट्रीय अल्पसंख्यक आयोग अधिनियम 1992 के तहत राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर कितने धार्मिक अल्पसंख्यक समुदाय अधिसूचित हैं?
o: 6 communities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Parsis, and Jains)
e: National Commission for Minorities Act, 1992 ke teht kendra star par 6 alpsankhyak (minority) samuday adhisoochit (notified) hain - Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Parsi (Zoroastrian) aur Jain. Iski suchi mein aksar 5 naam likhe jaakte hain kyunki Jain samuday ko baad mein 2014 mein shaamil kiya gaya; isliye sahi jawab 6 hi hai. Ye aayog alpsankhyakon ke vikas ke liye yojnaon ka mulyankan, unke adhikaron ki raksha ke sujhav aur shikayat (complaints) sunne ka kaam karti hai. Rajya star par alag rajya alpsankhyak aayog bhi ban sakti hain, jinke kshetraadhikar alag hote hain. Exam point: kendra star ke notified minority = 6 samuday (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Parsi, Jain) - NCM Act, 1992.

qe: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) acquired full statutory powers under which legislative enactment?
qh: भारतीय प्रतिभूति और विनिमय बोर्ड (SEBI) ने किस कानून के तहत पूर्ण वैधानिक शक्तियां प्राप्त कीं?
e: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) ko 1992 mein Parliament ke SEBI Act ke through poori statutory shaktiyan mili - isse pehle SEBI 1988 mein sirf ek sarkari aadesh (resolution) se bani sanstha thi aur uske paas adhikarik jaanch ya saja dene ki shakti nahi thi; SEBI Act, 1992 ke baad wo share bazaar (securities market) ka niyamak ban gaya, jo company list karne (listing), insider trading, mutual funds aur brokeron ke kaam par niyamak shaktiyan rakhta hai. SEBI ke teen bade kaam hain - niveshakaon (investors) ki raksha, market ka vikas aur market ka niyaman. Capital Issues (Control) Act, 1947 purana kanoon tha, Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956 exchange ke kaam ke liye hai, aur Companies Act, 2013 company ke prashasan ke liye. Exam point: SEBI = SEBI Act, 1992 se statutory powers (1988 mein executive body ke roop mein shuruaat).

qe: The National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) is statutory body established under which Act, and who is its ex-officio Chairperson?
qh: राष्ट्रीय आपदा प्रबंधन प्राधिकरण (NDMA) किस अधिनियम के तहत स्थापित है और इसका पदेन अध्यक्ष कौन होता है?
o: Civil Defence Act, 1968; chaired by the Union Home Minister
National Environmental Mitigation Act, 2002; chaired by the Environment Minister
Armed Forces Special Emergency Act; chaired by the Chief of Defence Staff
Disaster Management Act, 2005; chaired by the Prime Minister
e: National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) ko Disaster Management Act, 2005 ke teht banaya gaya, aur iske Padhin (ex-officio) Adhyaksh Bharat ke Pradhan Mantri hote hain - yani aapda (disaster) ke mamle mein sabse upar ki sanstha ke pramukh PM khud hote hain, jisse samanvay aur turant nirnay lene ki shakti badhti hai. NDMA ki salah se aapda se juda niyamak (guidelines), manak (standards) aur purvabhyas (mock drills) ki vyavastha banti hai; NDRF (National Disaster Response Force) bhi isi dhanche ke table kaam karti hai. 'Civil Defence Act, 1968', 'National Environmental Mitigation Act' ya 'Armed Forces Special Emergency Act' - inmein se koi NDMA ka aadhar nahi hai, aur ye aadhaar kendra ke pramukh (PM) ke haath mein hona chahiye. Exam point: NDMA = Disaster Management Act, 2005; adhyaksh (ex-officio) Pradhan Mantri.

qe: Under the Narcotics Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985, the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) was established in which year?
qh: NDPS अधिनियम 1985 के तहत नारकोटिक्स कंट्रोल ब्यूरो (NCB) की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: Narcotics Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985 ke teht Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) ki sthapna 1986 mein hui - NDPS Act 1985 mein aaya, par agency ka gathan aagle saal (1986) mein kiya gaya, taaki nashile padarth (narcotics), psychotropic substances aur unke avaidh (illegal) vyapar aur nirmaan ki rok-thaam ho sake. Isliye sahi jawab 1986 hai; 1985 kanoon ka saal hai, 1990 ya 1998 koi aankde nahi hain. NCB kendra Grih Mantralaya ke aadhin kaam karta hai aur rajya police/customs ke saath mil kar drug traficking ke mamlon ki jaanch karta hai. Exam point: NDPS Act = 1985, NCB ki sthapna = 1986 (Grih Mantralaya ke aadhin).

qe: The Atomic Energy Commission (AEC) of India functions under the direct administrative charge of:
qh: भारत का परमाणु ऊर्जा आयोग (AEC) किसके सीधे प्रशासनिक नियंत्रण में कार्य करता है?
o: The Prime Minister of India (Department of Atomic Energy)
e: Atomic Energy Commission (AEC) ka prashasan seedhe Pradhan Mantri ke aadhin aane wale Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) ke through hota hai - yani AEC, Bhabha Atomic Research Centre jaise anusandhan (research) kendra aur atomic power projects sab isi department ke daayre mein aate hain, aur iski adhyakshta bhi aam taur par DAE ke sachiv (secretary) karte hain jo PM ke daayre mein report karte hain. Raksha Mantralaya, DRDO ya Vigyan aur Praudyogiki Mantralaya iske prashasnik niyantran mein nahi hain, kyunki atomic energy ko seedha uchchtam star par rakh kar suraksha aur gopniyata (secrecy) bani rahti hai. Exam point: AEC/DAE = seedhe Pradhan Mantri ke aadhin (Department of Atomic Energy), na ki Vigyan Mantralaya ke.

qe: The National Statistical Office (NSO) was created in 2019 by restructuring and merging which two apex statistical bodies?
qh: राष्ट्रीय सांख्यिकी कार्यालय (NSO) का गठन 2019 में किन दो प्रमुख सांख्यिकीय निकायों के विलय द्वारा किया गया था?
o: Directorate of Economics and National Accounts Division
National Sample Survey Office (NSSO) and Central Statistics Office (CSO)
Indian Statistical Institute and RBI Data Cell
Planning Data Unit and Census Commission
e: National Statistical Office (NSO) 2019 mein banaya gaya, jisne do puraani sansthaon ko mila diya - National Sample Survey Office (NSSO), jo gharelu (household) survankshan aur sarvekshan chalata tha, aur Central Statistics Office (CSO), jo rashtriya aay (national income), saalana GDP anka aur CPI jaise soochak banata tha. In dono ko jodne se data ke sanchay, prakriya aur pradaan (dissemination) ka kaam ek hi chhat ke neeche aa gaya, jisse MoSPI ko sahyog milta hai. Indian Statistical Institute ek alag sanstha hai (uska apna kanoon hai), RBI Data Cell ek chhota khanda hai aur Planning Data Unit/Census Commission jaise naam NSO ke gathan se juda nahi hain. Exam point: NSO (2019) = NSSO + CSO ka sammilan (MoSPI ke teht).

qe: Which attached executive office under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare is responsible for implementing the Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY scheme?
qh: स्वास्थ्य एवं परिवार कल्याण मंत्रालय के तहत कौन सा कार्यालय आयुष्मान भारत PM-JAY योजना को लागू करने के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
o: National Institute of Health and Family Welfare
e: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) ko lagu karne wali attached executive sanstha National Health Authority (NHA) hai, jo Swasthya aur Parivaar Kalyan Mantralaya ke aadhin kaam karti hai aur yojana ka design, funding, IT platform aur rajya aayuktaon (State Health Agencies) ke saath samanvay dekhti hai. DGHS (Directorate General of Health Services) sarkari aspataal aur sehat vyavastha ka purana dhaancha dekhta hai, NIHFW training aur research karta hai, aur Central Medical Services Society dawa kharid mein sahyog deta hai - inmein se kisi ke paas PM-JAY chalane ka mandate nahi hai. Exam point: PM-JAY ka mutabiat/implementation = National Health Authority (NHA), Swasthya Mantralaya ke aadhin attached office.

qe: The National Green Tribunal (NGT) established under the NGT Act, 2010 is statutorily mandated to dispose of environmental applications within:
qh: NGT अधिनियम 2010 के तहत गठित राष्ट्रीय हरित अधिकरण (NGT) को पर्यावरणीय आवेदनों का निपटारा कितने समय के भीतर करना अनिवार्य है?
o: 6 months from the date of filing
e: National Green Tribunal (NGT) Act, 2010 ke anusaar NGT ko pariyavaran (environment) se judi aavedan (applications) ko 6 mahine ke andar nipatana (dispose) hota hai, aur is samay-seema ka paalan karne ke liye NGT ko apne aadesh (order) ki taareekh aur karan likhna hote hain - agar kisi mamle mein zyada samay lage to uske karan darj karne padte hain (Act ka Section 18). NGT ke paas civil court jaisi shaktiyan hain aur ye pariyavaran ke mamlon mein aane wale vivadon par faisla deta hai; 3 mahine, 12 mahine ya 'koi samay-seema nahi' wale vikalp kanoon ke aankde se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: NGT = pariyavaran aavedan 6 mahine ke andar nipatane ka lakshya (NGT Act, 2010, Section 18).

qe: Which regulatory body was replaced by the Competition Commission of India (CCI) under the Competition Act, 2002?
qh: प्रतिस्पर्धा अधिनियम 2002 के तहत भारतीय प्रतिस्पर्धा आयोग (CCI) द्वारा किस पुरानी संस्था को प्रतिस्थापित किया गया था?
o: Bureau of Industrial and Financial Reconstruction (BIFR)
Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices (MRTP) Commission
e: Competition Act, 2002 ke teht Competition Commission of India (CCI) ne Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices (MRTP) Commission ka kaam sambhala - MRTP Commission 1969 wale kanoon ke teht bani thi aur wo mukhya roop se ekadhikari (monopoly) aur pratibandhak vyapar vyavhar (restrictive trade practices) dekhti thi, par 1991 ke udarikaran (liberalisation) ke baad naye niyamon ki zarurat padi, isliye 2002 mein naya kanoon bankar CCI aayi aur MRTP Commission hata di gayi. BIFR beemar (sick) kampaon ka kaam dekhti thi (ab samapt), Tariff Commission daam-dekhti (tariffs) thi aur FIPB videshi nivesh ki manzoori dekhti thi. Exam point: MRTP Commission (1969) ki jagah CCI aayi (Competition Act, 2002 ke teht).

qe: Under the Protection of Human Rights (Amendment) Act, 2019, who is eligible to be appointed as the Chairperson of a State Human Rights Commission (SHRC)?
qh: मानव अधिकार संरक्षण (संशोधन) अधिनियम 2019 के तहत राज्य मानवाधिकार आयोग (SHRC) का अध्यक्ष बनने के लिए कौन पात्र है?
o: A person who has been a Chief Justice of a High Court OR a Judge of a High Court
Any serving District Judge with 15 years seniority
Only a retired Chief Justice of a High Court
e: Protection of Human Rights (Amendment) Act, 2019 ke anusaar Rajya Manvadhikar Aayog (SHRC) ka adhyaksh banne ke liye aisa vyakti chahiye jo High Court ka Mukhya Nyayadhish (Chief Justice) raha ho ya High Court ka Nyayadhish (Judge) raha ho - isse pehle keval Chief Justice wale niyam se adhik log yogya nahi ho paate the, isliye jyaada lafable (flexible) kiya gaya. Isi sanshodhan ne aayog ke sadasyaon ki sankhya aur unke kshetra (member secretary aadi) ke niyam bhi badle. Rajya ka Advocate General ek executive pad hai (rajya sarkar ka vidhik salahkar), aur keval serving District Judge ka is pad par aana samvidhan ke pravdhan se mel nahi khaata. Exam point: SHRC adhyaksh = High Court ke Chief Justice ya High Court ke Judge rahe vyakti (2019 ke sanshodhan ke baad).

qe: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) functions as a statutory authority under the administrative jurisdiction of which Union Ministry?
qh: भारतीय विशिष्ट पहचान प्राधिकरण (UIDAI) किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय के प्रशासनिक अधिकार क्षेत्र में एक वैधानिक प्राधिकरण के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
e: Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) ko Aadhaar Act, 2016 ke teht statutory darja mila aur ye Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) ke aadhin kaam karti hai - Aadhaar ke panjikaran (enrolment), praman (authentication) aur suraksha (security) ki zimmedari isi ke paas hai. 2015 mein UIDAI ko Yojana Aayog (Planning Commission) se MeitY ke paas bheja gaya tha, isliye 'Ministry of Statistics', Grih Mantralaya ya Karmik Mantralaya wale vikalp galat hain (Aadhaar Act ke baad UIDAI pura niyantran MeitY ke saath hai). Iska mukhyaalay Delhi mein hai aur iske kshetriya karyalay bhi hote hain. Exam point: UIDAI = Aadhaar Act, 2016 ki statutory authority, MeitY ke prashasnik niyantran mein.

qe: Under Section 20(1) of the Right to Information Act, 2005, what is the maximum penalty the Information Commission can impose on a defaulting Public Information Officer (PIO)?
qh: RTI अधिनियम 2005 की धारा 20(1) के तहत सूचना आयोग किसी दोषी जन सूचना अधिकारी (PIO) पर अधिकतम कितना जुर्माना लगा सकता है?
o: Rs. 25,000 (at Rs. 250 per day of delay)
e: RTI Act ke Section 20(1) ke anusaar soochna aayog (Information Commission) default k karne wale Lok Soochna Adhikari (PIO) par Rs 250 prati din ke hisaab se jurya (penalty) laga sakti hai, jiska uchchtam (maximum) Rs 25,000 hai - yani agar ek din ki deri bhi hui to din-ginti shuru, aur 100 din bhi ho gaye to bhi jurya 25,000 se zyada nahi ho sakti. Jurya lagaane ke saath aayog vishleshan (disciplinary) karyavahi ki sifarish bhi kar sakti hai. 50,000, 10,000 ya 1,00,000 wale aankde kanoon mein hai nahi, isliye ye vikalp galat hain; samvidhan mein 250 aur 25,000 ka hi jod likha hai. Exam point: PIO par RTI jurya = Rs 250 per din, adhiktam Rs 25,000 (Section 20(1)); disciplinary action ki sifarish alag se.

qe: The Directorate of Enforcement (ED) functions as a specialized economic financial investigation agency under which administrative Department?
qh: प्रवर्तन निदेशालय (ED) किस प्रशासनिक विभाग के तहत एक विशेष वित्तीय जांच एजेंसी के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: Internal Security Division, Ministry of Home Affairs
Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance
e: Directorate of Enforcement (ED) kendra ke Vitta Mantralaya (Ministry of Finance) ke Revenue Department ke aadhin kaam karta hai - yahi vibhaag aay (tax) aur vittiya zhokha (financial fraud) wali jaanch agencies ka prashasnik niyantran dekhta hai, isliye ED bhi isi ke table report deta hai. ED ke do bade kaam FEMA (videshi mudra ke ullanghan ki jaanch) aur PMLA (kaale dhan ki jaanch aur sampatti kunji karna) hain, aur ye Mukhya Niveshak/Vitta Sachiv ke table kaam karta hai. Department of Economic Affairs niti (policy) ka kaam dekhta hai, Department of Financial Services bank aur bima sansthon ke prashasan ka, aur Internal Security Division Grih Mantralaya ke andar hai. Exam point: ED = Department of Revenue, Vitta Mantralaya ke aadhin (Mukhya Niveshak ewam Vitta Sachiv ke table).

qe: Under the Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) Act, 2003, what is the unique statutory tenure of the Central Vigilance Commissioner?
qh: केंद्रीय सतर्कता आयोग (CVC) अधिनियम 2003 के तहत केंद्रीय सतर्कता आयुक्त का कार्यकाल क्या होता है?
o: 4 years or until the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier
6 years or until the age of 65 years
5 years or until the age of 65 years
3 years or until the age of 70 years
e: Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) Act, 2003 ke anusaar Central Vigilance Commissioner ka karyakal 4 saal ya 65 saal ki aayu (jo pehle aa jaye) tak hota hai, aur isi tarah Krishna Aayukta (Vigilance Commissioners) ka karyakal bhi tay hai - yeh vyavastha commissioner ko ek nishchit avadhi deti hai, jismein sarkaar unhe manmane se hata nahi sakti (hataya jaana alag pravdhan se hota hai). 6 saal/65, 5 saal/65 ya 3 saal/70 wale vikalp CVC Act ke aankdon se mel nahi khaate; aapko yaad rakhna hai ki rashtrapati niyukti karte hain aur CVC central sarkari offices ki vigilance ki pramukh sanstha hai. Exam point: CVC ka karyakal = 4 saal ya 65 saal ki aayu (jo pehle); CVC Act, 2003 ke teht niyukti rashtrapati dwara.

qe: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) traces its primary statutory investigative and police powers to which legislation?
qh: केंद्रीय जांच ब्यूरो (CBI) अपनी प्राथमिक वैधानिक जांच और पुलिस शक्तियां किस कानून से प्राप्त करती है?
e: Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) apni police jaanch wali saari shaktiyan aur kshetraadhikar Delhi Special Police Establishment (DSPE) Act, 1946 se leti hai - ye kanoon British kaal mein Delhi mein yuddh (war) se jude kharch aur bhrashtachar ki jaanch ke liye bana tha, aur 1963 mein isi DSPE ke Bharatiya Police Force (CBI) wale naam se jaanane laga. Isiliye CBI ki jaanch ke liye samanvayik (state) sarkar ki sehmati (consent) chahiye hoti hai (Delhi aur UTs chhod kar). CVC Act 2003 CVC ki banavat hai, National Security Act 1980 nirudan (detention) ka kanoon hai, aur Police Act 1861 rajya police ke liye. Exam point: CBI = DSPE Act, 1946 ke teht police shaktiyan (DSPE ke 'Special Police Establishment' wale gun).

qe: Under Section 4B of the DSPE Act (as amended by the Lokpal Act), who comprises the statutory committee for appointing the Director of the CBI?
qh: संशोधित DSPE अधिनियम के तहत CBI निदेशक की नियुक्ति के लिए वैधानिक समिति में कौन शामिल होता है?
o: Prime Minister (Chairperson), Leader of the Opposition in Lok Sabha, and the Chief Justice of India (or a nominated SC Judge)
Chief Justice of India and four senior-most judges of the Supreme Court
Prime Minister, Home Minister, and National Security Advisor
Union Home Minister, Cabinet Secretary, and CVC
e: DSPE Act ke Section 4B ke anusaar CBI ke Nideshak (Director) ki niyukti ke liye ek statutory chayan samiti banaayi gayi hai, jismein Pradhan Mantri (adhyaksh), Lok Sabha mein Vipaksh ka Neta (Leader of Opposition) aur Bhartiya uchchatam nyayalay ke Mukhya Nyayadhish ya unke dwara naamit koi sarvochch nyayadhish sadasya hote hain - is samiti ki sifarish par niyukti ki jaati hai, aur Lokpal Act ke sanshodhan ke baad isi samiti ki vyavastha aur spasht hui. Ismein Grih Mantri, Cabinet Secretary, NSA ya CVC shaamil nahi hote; ye design hi CBI ki niyukt wala chayan ko swatantrata deta hai. Exam point: CBI Director ki chayan samiti = PM + Lok Sabha LoP + CJI/SC judge (DSPE Act ka Section 4B, Lokpal Act se sanshodhit).

qe: Under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, what is the executive hierarchy of the National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)?
qh: विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण अधिनियम 1987 के तहत NALSA का संस्थागत पदानुक्रम क्या है?
o: President of India is Patron-in-Chief and CJI is Executive Chairman
Chief Justice of India is Patron-in-Chief, and the second senior-most Judge of the Supreme Court is the Executive Chairman
Union Law Minister is Patron-in-Chief and Attorney General is Executive Chairman
e: Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 ke anusaar National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) ke sareekhon mein Bhartiya uchchatam nyayalay ke Mukhya Nyayadhish Patron-in-Chief (sanrakshak) ki bhoomika mein hote hain aur uchchatam nyayalay ke dusre sabse varishth (senior-most) nyayadhish Executive Chairman ki bhoomika mein - isse muft kanooni sahayata (free legal aid) aur lok adalat ki vyavastha ko nyayapalika ka sabse uchch star netritva milta hai. Isi tarah rajya legal services authority ke adhyaksh rajya High Court ke Chief Justice hote hain. Rashtrapati, Solicitor General ya Vidhi Mantri is dhanche ke padadhikari nahi hain - ye poori vyavastha nyayapalika ke netritva mein isliye rakhi gayi hai ki kaanooni sahayata sabko samaan roop se mile. Exam point: NALSA = CJI Patron-in-Chief, SC ke second senior-most judge Executive Chairman (1987 ka kanoon).

qe: Under the Right to Information Act, 2005, within what maximum timeline must requested information be furnished if it concerns the life or liberty of a person?
qh: RTI अधिनियम 2005 के तहत, यदि मांगी गई जानकारी किसी व्यक्ति के जीवन या स्वतंत्रता से संबंधित हो, तो उसे कितने समय में उपलब्ध कराना अनिवार्य है?
o: Within 48 hours of receipt of the request
e: RTI Act ke Section 7(1) mein ek khaas proviso hai - agar maangi gayi soochna kisi vyakti ke jeevan (life) ya vyaktigat swatantrata (liberty) se judi ho, to Lok Soochna Adhikari (PIO) ko 48 ghante ke andar jawab dena hota hai, jabki samanya mamle mein 30 din ka samay hota hai. Isliye 24 ghante, 15 din ya 7 din wale vikalp galat hain; 48 ghante hi aadhikarik samay hai. Iska maksad yahi hai ki kisi ki jaan ya azadi ka sawaal ho to jaankari mein deri kisi ki jaan le sakti hai; jaise kisi bandi (detenu) ya mareez (patient) se judi jaankari. Haan, agar jaankari doosri sanstha ki ho to samay thoda badh sakta hai, par life/liberty wale mamle mein ye chhoot nahi milti. Exam point: life/liberty ki soochna = 48 ghante (RTI Act, Section 7(1) ka proviso), samanya mamle mein 30 din.

qe: The Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) was originally established in 1964 following the recommendations of which Committee?
qh: केंद्रीय सतर्कता आयोग (CVC) की स्थापना 1964 में किस समिति की सिफारिशों पर की गई थी?
o: K. Santhanam Committee on Prevention of Corruption
e: Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) 1964 mein K. Santhanam Committee on Prevention of Corruption ki sifarish par bana - Santhanam Committee ne dekha ki bhrashtachar rokne ke liye ek swatantra (independent) sanstha chahiye jo sarkari sachivalaya ki nigrani kar sake, aur uske sujhav se pehle 1964 mein executive aadesh se CVC bani, phir 2003 mein kanoon bankar use statutory darja mila. Administrative Reforms Commission (1966), Sarkaria Commission (1983) aur Gorwala Committee (1951) apne-apne kshetraon ki report ke liye jaane jaate hain - CVC ka janm Santhanam Committee se hi jyda hai. Exam point: CVC = Santhanam Committee (1964) ki sifarish par, statutory aadhar CVC Act 2003 se.

qe: Under the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013, what is the maximum statutory composition of the Lokpal body?
qh: लोकपाल और लोकायुक्त अधिनियम 2013 के तहत लोकपाल संस्था की अधिकतम वैधानिक संरचना क्या है?
o: A Chairperson and up to 4 Members
A Chairperson and up to 8 Members (50% of whom must be Judicial Members)
e: Lokpal aur Lokayuktas Act, 2013 ke anusaar Lokpal ki adhiktam (maximum) sansrachana ek Adhyaksh (Chairperson) aur adhiktam 8 sadasyaon ki ho sakti hai, aur inmein kam se kam 50% sadasya nyayik (judicial) prishthbhumi ke hone chahiye - yani Lokpal ka aadha hissa High Court judges/HC Chief Justice ya Supreme Court judge rah chuke vyakti hote hain, jisse jaanch mein kanooni mazbooti aati hai. Isi tarah kuchh sanshodhan ke daayre mein Lokpal ke adhyaksh bhi nyayadhish (ya prashiddh vyakti) ho sakte hain. Baaki sadasya bhrashtachar rokne, vittiya shaasan, vigyapan (vigilance) aur insaaf ke kshetra ke hote hain. 6, 4 ya 10 wale vikalp aankdon se mel nahi khaate. Exam point: Lokpal = 1 adhyaksh + adhiktam 8 sadasya, jismein 50% judicial (Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013).

qe: Under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972, which specialized statutory body is mandated to combat organized wildlife crime across India?
qh: वन्यजीव (संरक्षण) अधिनियम 1972 के तहत संगठित वन्यजीव अपराध से निपटने के लिए कौन सा निकाय अधिकृत है?
e: Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 ke teht 2007 mein Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (WCCB) ko banaya gaya - ye ek bahu-vishayak (multidisciplinary) statutory sanstha hai jo vanjeevon (wildlife) ki taskari (trafficking), avaidh shikar (poaching) aur vanjeev angon ke vyapar (trade) par rok lagane ke liye bani; ismein van vibhag, police, customs aur anya agency ke adhikari shaamil hote hain, aur ye idhar-udhar ke vanjeev aapraadhon ki jaankari jama karke unhe jaanchti hai. Animal Welfare Board pashu kalyan ke liye hai, Central Zoo Authority chidiyaghar (zoos) ko manzoori aur manak deti hai, aur NTCA baghon (tigers) ke sanrakshan ka kaam dekhti hai - inmein se kisi ka kaam wildlife crime ki jaanch nahi hai. Exam point: WCCB = Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 ke teht 2007 mein banaya gaya, wildlife aapraadhon ki jaanch agency.

qe: How did the Right to Information (Amendment) Act, 2019 modify the terms and conditions of Information Commissioners?
qh: सूचना का अधिकार (संशोधन) अधिनियम 2019 ने सूचना आयुक्तों की सेवा शर्तों में क्या बदलाव किया?
o: Fixed their tenure permanently at 6 years
Replaced the fixed 5-year tenure and salary parity with Election Commissioners, vesting power in the Central Government to prescribe tenure, salaries, and allowances
Brought the Commission under direct military administration
Abolished the office of State Information Commissions
e: RTI (Amendment) Act, 2019 ne soochna aayuktaon (Information Commissioners) ke karyakal (tenure) aur vetan ka purana niyam badal diya - pehle CIC/IC ka karyakal 5 saal ka hota tha aur unka vetan-chatur (salary parity) nirvachan aayuktaon (Election Commissioners) ke barabar tha, lekin sanshodhan ke baad karyakal, vetan aur anya sevayein kendra sarkar niyamon ke teht tay karne lagee, jisse ye vyavastha kendra ke adheen ho gayi. Sanshodhan ne aayuktaon ke pad ya adhikaaron ko samapt nahi kiya, unhe sthapit nahi kiya, aur na hi state aayog (SIC) khatm kiye gaye. 'Fixed 6 saal' wala vikalp bhi kanoon mein nahi hai. Exam point: RTI sanshodhan 2019 = tenure/salary ka nirdharan kendra sarkar ke niyamon par (pehle 5 saal + EC ke samaan vetan).

qe: The Directorate General of Trade Remedies (DGTR) functions under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry primarily to recommend:
qh: व्यापार उपचार महानिदेशालय (DGTR) मुख्य रूप से किसकी सिफारिश करने के लिए कार्य करता है?
o: Trade defense measures such as anti-dumping duties, countervailing duties, and safeguard measures against unfair foreign imports
Direct income tax slabs for exporting firms
e: Directorate General of Trade Remedies (DGTR) Vaanijya aur Udyog Mantralaya (Ministry of Commerce and Industry) ke aadhin aane wala ek bahu-vishayak jaanch-o-salah dene wala karyalaya hai, jiska kaam anya deshon se hone wale anuchit (unfair) aayat (imports) ke khilaf jaanch karke sarkar ko 'trade defence' ke upayon ki sifarish karna hai - jaise anti-dumping shulk (duty), countervailing duty (subsidy-wale aayat par) aur safeguard measures (achanak badhi aayat par seemit samay ke liye). Ye bharat ki aayat (imports) ko nishpaksh (fair) banaye rakhne ka dhancha hai. Currency devaluation, income tax slabs ya shipping freight charges DGTR ka kaam nahi hai - wo RBI/Vitta mantralaya aur shipping adhikariyon ke kshetra hain. Exam point: DGTR = Vaanijya Mantralaya ke aadhin, anti-dumping/countervailing/safeguard measures ki sifarish karta hai.

qe: Under the University Grants Commission (UGC) Act, 1956, what is the primary statutory function of the UGC?
qh: विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग (UGC) अधिनियम 1956 के तहत UGC का प्राथमिक वैधानिक कार्य क्या है?
o: Direct administration of all state primary schools
Coordination, determination, and maintenance of standards of teaching, examination, and research in universities
To conduct civil service entrance examinations
e: University Grants Commission (UGC) Act, 1956 ke anusaar UGC ka mukhya statutory kaam vishwavidyalayaon (universities) mein shikshan, pareeksha aur anusandhan ke manakon ka samanvay (coordination), nirdharan (determination) aur rakh-rakhav (maintenance) karna hai - iske teht UGC manak tay karta hai, colleges ko manyata (affiliation) deta hai, anudaan (grants) deta hai aur nayi vishwavidyalayaon/pathyakramon (courses) ki manzoori mein salah deta hai. Prathmik vidyalayaon ka prashasan, videshi vishwavidyalayaon ke liye professsoron ki bharti ya civil service ki pareeksha lena UGC ka kaam nahi hai (civil services UPSC leta hai, school shiksha rajya/school boards dekhte hain). Exam point: UGC (1956) = university education ke manak tay karna, samanvay aur anudaan - niyamak (regulator) bhi hai jabki manak setter bhi.

qe: Which specialized statutory authority governs inter-country and in-country child adoptions in India?
qh: भारत में बच्चों के अंतर-देशीय और घरेलू दत्तक ग्रहण (Adoption) को कौन सा वैधानिक प्राधिकरण नियंत्रित करता है?
o: National Commission for Protection of Child Rights
e: CARA (Central Adoption Resource Authority) bharat mein antardeshiya (inter-country) aur deshiya (in-country) dono tarah ke 'god lene' (adoption) ka niyamak (regulator) hai - 2015 mein ise ek statutory sanstha banaya gaya aur ye Mahila awam Bal Vikas Mantralaya (Ministry of Women and Child Development) ke aadhin kaam karta hai, jahan 'Hague Convention' ke usoolon ke hisaab se god lene ki prakriya, anath (orphan) bachchon ka data (CARINGS portal) aur vidheshi mata-pita ki patrata (eligibility) dekhi jaati hai. NCW mahilaon ke mamlon ki aayog hai, NCPCR bachchon ke adhikaron ki raksha dekhta hai (par adoption ki manzoori/niyaman CARA karta hai), aur Child Welfare Police alag vyavastha hai. Exam point: adoption ka regulator = CARA (Hague Convention ke tahat), Mahila awam Bal Vikas Mantralaya ke aadhin.

qe: What is the primary statutory difference between the Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) and the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)?
qh: केंद्रीय सतर्कता आयोग (CVC) और केंद्रीय जांच ब्यूरो (CBI) के बीच प्राथमिक वैधानिक अंतर क्या है?
o: CVC prosecutes private companies, while CBI only investigates politicians
CBI is a constitutional body, whereas CVC is an executive committee
CVC is a statutory supervisory and integrity watchdog that superintends the CBI in anti-corruption matters, whereas CBI is an investigating police agency
There is no functional or legal difference
e: CVC aur CBI dono milte-julte naam hain par unke kaam bilkul alag hain: CVC ek statutory supervisory aur integrity watchdog (sachchai ki nigrani sanstha) hai jo sarkari karmachariyon ki vigilance vyavastha dekhta hai aur anti-corruption ke mamlon mein CBI ko nirdesh (superintendence) deta hai; jabki CBI ek jaanch (investigating) karne wali police agency hai jo DSPE Act ke teht FIR darj karti hai, chaan-bin (investigation) karti hai aur adalat mein chargesheet daalti hai. CVC ke paas khud FIR darj karne ya giraftari karne ki shakti nahi hoti; wo CBI se jaanch karwata hai. CBI koi samvidhanik sanstha nahi hai (usi tarah CVC bhi nahi), isliye 'CBI constitutional body' wala vikalp galat hai. Exam point: CVC = supervisory/integrity watchdog (anti-corruption mein CBI par nigrani), CBI = jaanch aur chargesheet wali police agency.

qe: The National Commission for Women (NCW) was established as a statutory body in January 1992 under which Act?
qh: राष्ट्रीय महिला आयोग (NCW) की स्थापना जनवरी 1992 में किस अधिनियम के तहत की गई थी?
o: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
e: National Commission for Women (NCW) National Commission for Women Act, 1990 ke teht bani aur January 1992 se karyar hui - ye mahilaon ke adhikaron ki raksha ke liye shikayat (complaints) sunne, mahilaon se juda kanoonon ke karyanvayan ki samiksha karne aur sarkar ko sujhav dene ka kaam karti hai. Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 gharelu hinsa se bachne wale kanoon hai, Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1983 aur Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 alag-alag apo-dhan aur aapradh ke kanoon hain - ye NCW ke banana ka aadhar nahi hain. Isi tarah sashastr bal (Sashastra Bal) wali baat alag hai aur rajya mahila aayog bhi banti hain. Exam point: NCW = National Commission for Women Act, 1990 (karyar January 1992); mahila adhikaron ke liye statutory aayog.
